texts.en:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed the Equal Standing Act resolution, forbidding empires from holding the Non-Interference or Aggressive Interference policies.

Our Empire is currently in breach of this resolution. Shall we change our policies to be in compliance?

label.zh: 我们将保持现有的政策不变。
label.en: We will retain our current policies.
